newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel stock up on stake offer report.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel stock up on stake offer report.

text.p: Utility Tractebel jumped on the Brussels bourse on Tuesday in reaction to a Belgian press article which said holding GBL and affiliated companies were offering control of Tractebel to fellow Belgian holding SGB at 14,500 francs per Tractebel share.
None of the parties mentioned in the article either were available to confirm the newspaper report or able to confirm it.
At 0855 GMT, Tractebel shares stood 2.9 percent higher at 13,300 after earlier peaking at 13,550. "Some traders bought on the story at the start and then took profits," one dealer said.
Another said that while the market thought there was "probably some thing in the pipeline" it seemed unlikely SGB would buy at a such a premium to the market price.

He said if SGB did pay such a premium for the stock, it would almost certainly be obliged under Belgian law to make a public offer at the same price for remaining Tractebel shares, something which "they could not afford to do."
"The dust will rapidly settle on the market," he added. The dealer said it was more likely there would be an exchange of participations between the two holdings than a direct sale.
Electrafina, part of the GBL group, also benefitted, rising 3.3 percent to 2,800.
